title: A rejected lazy claim ends its turn with one terminal error and stays fail-closed
behavior: When the Local VM dies between dispatch and the first screen call, the fired lazy claim rejects: the firing call is refused honestly instead of as contention, exactly one terminal computer-unavailable error activity lands, the turn ends with the bot idle rather than busy behind a refusing gate, and a later screen call fails because teardown revoked the bridge capability.

steps.text: Use the VM when it is ready.
